description: This bar chart illustrates two distinct metrics, "Accuracy (%)" and "Token Count," across four different categories. The horizontal axis serves as the category axis, grouping the bars into two distinct sections corresponding to the two metrics labeled at the top of the chart, without a specific overall axis label. The chart utilizes dual vertical value axes to accommodate the different metrics. The left vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The right vertical axis is labeled "Token Count" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800 with tick marks at intervals of 100. The bars are grouped within each metric section and are color-coded according to a legend at the bottom: red for "CoT," orange for "CoD," light blue for "CCoT," and green for "CoUT." In the "Accuracy (%)" group on the left, the values are 91.19 for CoT (the tallest bar in this group), 80.89 for CoD (the shortest bar in this group), 88.50 for CCoT, and 88.40 for CoUT. In the "Token Count" group on the right, the values are 676.85 for CoT (the tallest bar in this group), 534.24 for CoD, 445.91 for CCoT, and 354.46 for CoUT (the shortest bar in this group). Every bar is visually emphasized with a thin black outline and is annotated with its exact numerical value positioned directly above it. The bars within each group are arranged in a consistent order corresponding to the legend rather than being sorted by numerical value.
